description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Saves new content into one of the user's editable CVs (made with create_cv_variant): headline, summary, experience, projects, skills and other sections. Each section given replaces that section (name, email, phone, location, links, language, title and the template and accent color too); the rest stays. The primary CV (CV chính) is not changed by this tool (see set_primary_cv). Returns a link where the user reviews the saved CV.

changes.description: Only the fields and sections to change, in the CV's language. Change name, email, phone, location and links only to values the user gave you.

achievements.description: Awards, hackathons, scholarships. Replaces the whole section; omit to keep it as is.

date.description: As the user writes it, e.g. "Mar 2023" or "03/2023".

certifications.description: Replaces the whole section; omit to keep it as is.

experience.description: Work experience, newest first. Replaces the whole section; omit to keep it as is.
